messages:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem \u2014 need owners + dates for rollout-safety fixes: auto-rollback, flag scoping, recurrence detection.
Maria P: I can own auto-rollback. Will post multi-signal thresholds + brief canary plan by Thu EOD.
Jon S: I'll own blast-radius controls (flag scoping + saturation caps). Deliverable next Tue.
Irene C: I'll prototype recurrence detection (flag+model fingerprinting) and wire auto-epic if pattern repeats; target sprint end.
Taylor R: Can someone paste the postmortem link?
Alex K: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-22-service-degradation (see telemetry gaps).
Maria P: Current rollback is 5xx >2% global. Proposal: require 2 signals in 10m (p95 latency, user_error_rate, 5xx ramp) + cooldown to avoid thrash.
Jon S: Staged rollout + caps: 1% -> 10% -> 100% with guard timers; bucket_max_users=5k; add token budget so CI can't push to 100%. Also propose global quarantine switch with 30s TTL.
Taylor R: I'll draft a 1-page oncall checklist for validate->rollback->verify by Mon.
Irene C: Recurrence rule example: same flag+model => open remediation epic if >=3 incidents in 90d; will add clustering to reduce noise.
Maria P: Add synthetic probe on canary mirrors every 5m; I'll include in canary plan.
Jon S: Note infra review required for global switches and token enforcement; will loop infra when spec is ready.
Alex K: Action list to track: Maria (auto-rollback, Thu), Maria+Jon (canary+synthetic, next Tue), Jon (flag caps + quarantine spec, next Tue/Wed), Irene (recurrence + auto-epic, sprint end), Taylor (oncall checklist, Mon). Prioritize safety over velocity.
Alex K: @remind-bot set reminder "Rollout-safety sync" in 7 days.
remind-bot: Reminder set by Alex K: "Rollout-safety sync" in 7 days.
